mihomo.custom_config:
mode: global
proxies: [{name: Example, type: socks5, server: 192.0.2.1, port: 1080}]

pull.content:
log:
  level: info
  file: ./mosdns.log
api:
  http: 0.0.0.0:8338
plugins:
  - tag: lazy_cache
    type: cache
    args:
      size: 10240
      lazy_cache_ttl: 21600
      dump_file: ./cache.dump
      dump_interval: 300
  - tag: forward_local
    type: forward
    args:
      concurrent: 10
      upstreams:
        - addr: 223.5.5.5
        - addr: 119.29.29.29
  - tag: forward_remote
    type: forward
    args:
      concurrent: 5
      upstreams:
        - addr: https://1.1.1.1/dns-query
        - addr: https://dns.google/dns-query
  - tag: forward_remote_fallback
    type: forward
    args:
      concurrent: 10
      upstreams:
        - addr: 223.5.5.5
        - addr: 119.29.29.29
  - tag: remote_dns
    type: sequence
    args:
      - exec: query_summary forward_remote
      - exec: $forward_remote
      - matches:
          - '!has_resp'
        exec: reject 3
      - exec: ttl 1
  - tag: remote_dns_fallback
    type: sequence
    args:
      - exec: query_summary forward_remote_fallback
      - exec: $forward_remote_fallback
      - matches:
          - '!has_resp'
        exec: reject 3
  - tag: proxy_dns
    type: fallback
    args:
      primary: remote_dns
      secondary: remote_dns_fallback
      threshold: 500
      always_standby: false
  - tag: proxy_dns_seq
    type: sequence
    args:
      - exec: $proxy_dns
      - exec: accept
  - tag: china_dns
    type: sequence
    args:
      - exec: $lazy_cache
      - matches:
          - has_resp
        exec: accept
      - exec: query_summary forward_local
      - exec: $forward_local
      - matches:
          - '!has_resp'
        exec: reject 3
  - tag: sequence_main
    type: sequence
    args:
      - exec: metrics_collector metrics
      - exec: prefer_ipv4
      - exec: goto proxy_dns_seq
  - type: udp_server
    args:
      entry: sequence_main
      listen: :53
  - type: tcp_server
    args:
      entry: sequence_main
      listen: :53

runtime:
  worker_threads: 2
api:
  http:
    listen: 127.0.0.1:9199
log:
  level: info
plugins:
- tag: lazy_cache
  type: cache
  args:
    size: 10240
    lazy_cache_ttl: 3600
    short_circuit: true
- tag: local_probe_cache
  type: cache
  args:
    size: 2048
    short_circuit: false
- tag: forward_local
  type: forward
  args:
    concurrent: 2
    upstreams:
    - addr: udp://223.5.5.5
    - addr: udp://119.29.29.29
- tag: forward_remote
  type: forward
  args:
    concurrent: 1
    upstreams:
    - addr: https://1.1.1.1/dns-query
    - addr: https://8.8.8.8/dns-query
- tag: china_dns
  type: sequence
  args:
  - exec: $lazy_cache
  - exec: $forward_local
  - matches:
    - '!has_resp'
    exec: reject 3
- tag: local_probe
  type: sequence
  args:
  - exec: $local_probe_cache
  - matches:
    - '!has_resp'
    exec: $forward_local
  - exec: return
- tag: remote_dns
  type: sequence
  args:
  - exec: $forward_remote
  - matches:
    - '!has_resp'
    exec: reject 3
  - exec: ttl 1
- tag: proxy_dns_seq
  type: sequence
  args:
  - exec: goto remote_dns
- tag: default_direct_ip
  type: sequence
  args:
  - exec: accept
- tag: direct_ip
  type: sequence
  args:
  - exec: accept
- tag: ip_requery_proxy
  type: sequence
  args:
  - exec: drop_resp
  - exec: goto proxy_dns_seq
- tag: sequence_main
  type: sequence
  args:
  - exec: metrics_collector metrics
  - exec: prefer_ipv4
  - matches:
    - qtype 65 255
    exec: black_hole nodata short_circuit=true
  - exec: goto proxy_dns_seq
- tag: server_udp
  type: udp_server
  args:
    listen: 0.0.0.0:53
    entry: sequence_main
- tag: server_tcp
  type: tcp_server
  args:
    listen: 0.0.0.0:53
    entry: sequence_main
